title: Serialized profile addresses persist through the negative cache
fault_primitive: Existing MongoDB hotel address subdocuments are migrated to JSON string scalars; the stock reader caches partially decoded profiles without expiry
incident_class: Storage serialization contract regression during a catalog export/import migration
symptoms: Search and recommendation connections terminate in frontend GeoJSON encoding. All pods remain ready. Frontend logs show recovered nil-pointer panics. Profile decode errors disappear as partial objects become cache hits.
why_hard: The parent fixer restored the stock binary. This incident already uses it and leaves Deployments, ConfigMaps, Services and collection names unchanged. Hotel inventory exists with correct IDs and full address content but the wrong BSON representation. Successful RPCs and cache hits precede frontend rendering failures. Restart and rollback cannot repair data. Repairing MongoDB leaves indefinite cached partial profiles; flushing cache regenerates them.
expected_agent_pitfalls: Restore the stock profile binary as in the parent incident
Patch frontend to skip profiles, suppressing errors while losing results
Treat disappearing profile errors as recovery
Flush cache without correcting catalog serialization
mitigation_summary: Parse JSON address scalars back into embedded BSON using existing content, then flush the regenerable profile cache. No saved data or original manifests are required.
